maya: Quick heads-up — Nikita accepted the SE SWE role and is set to start May 26. Nikita is on F-1 OPT with current EAD exp 2025-08-10. We need to start STEM OPT extension paperwork ASAP. Can immigration team advise deadlines and docs? :wave:
leah: Hi! Yes — STEM OPT (24mo) requires I-983 and an I-765 filing to USCIS. Best practice: file I-765 up to 90 days before EAD expiry and ideally get receipt before expiry. We'll need photocopies of passport, I-94, current EAD, diploma, STEM I-983 training plan from manager, and DSO recommendation in SEVIS.
nikita: Thanks — I can gather docs. Quick Q: can I start remote on May 26 while we file? My current EAD covers until Aug 10, so should be fine? :thinking:
sam: From team side we're fine with remote start. We just need the I-983 filled — I'll draft the training plan. What fields do you need from me, Leah?
leah: Thanks Sam. For I-983 we need: employer EIN, position title, start date, stipend/compensation, expected learning objectives, mentor name/contact, and hours per week. I'll paste a minimal template below:
leah: ```
Position title: Software Engineer
Job start: 2025-05-26
Employer EIN: 81-1234567
Supervisor: Sam Patel, sam@redwood.com
Learning objectives: (2-3 bullet points)
Hours/week: 40
``` 
maya: Nikita, please upload scans to the HR portal folder: https://redwood.box.com/s/stem-opt-onboarding (please use filename pattern: lastname_firstname_doctype.pdf). We need everything by 2025-05-10 to prepare the packet.
nikita: Uploaded passport & EAD scan now. I'll ask Sam for the I-983 draft today. Thank you!
visa-bot: Reminder: STEM OPT recommended filing window opens 90 days before EAD expiry. Automatic reminder set for 2025-05-10.
raj: Any fee coverage? Do we reimburse mailing/certified mail costs for I-765? Budget question.
maya: Yes — Redwood covers USCIS filing fees and shipping for OPT/STEM paperwork. Submit expense via Ramp and tag 'immigration'.
leah: One more note: timeline — once we file I-765 we usually see receipt notice (Form I-797) in 2-3 weeks; adjudication can take 3-5 months. If receipt comes before Aug 10, Nikita's status is maintained. If there are RFEs we'll coordinate quickly.
nikita: Got it. If USCIS needs biometrics, will that be in-person? I don't know the nearest center yet.
leah: Biometrics appointments are local at ASC; USCIS schedules those automatically after filing. We'll help schedule if needed and reimburse travel. Keep DSO looped — they must enter the STEM recommendation in SEVIS before filing.
maya: Scheduling: Leah, can you do a 15-min sync with Sam and Nikita next week? I propose Wed 2025-04-30 10am PT. 
sam: Works for me.
nikita: Works for me too. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
leah: Added to calendar. I'll bring the I-983 checklist and a short walk-through of the I-765 online form.
maya: Perfect — marking this thread resolved after the call. I'll post a short post-call checklist.
nikita: Appreciate it! :pray:
